passage:
Woman: Riverside Community Leisure Centre, good morning, how can I help you?
Man: Hi, I saw your poster about the New Year Reset programme and I'd like some details.
Woman: Of course. What would you like to know?
Man: First of all, what exactly does it involve?
Woman: It's a six-week health course starting on Monday the 5th of January — gym access three times a week, one 45-minute fitness assessment, and a nutrition consultation with our dietitian.
Man: That sounds good. How much does it cost?
Woman: Six hundred and eighty yuan for the whole six weeks, which works out much cheaper than individual visits.
Man: And can I try it before signing up?
Woman: Yes, we offer one free trial session in either of the first two weekends of January.
Man: Great. Is the swimming pool included?
Woman: The pool is optional — eighty yuan extra if you want regular lane swimming. Three lane sessions per week, mornings only.
Man: I'll take the pool as well then. What are your opening hours in January?
Woman: Weekdays six thirty in the morning until ten at night, and weekends eight until nine. Last entry is half an hour before closing.
Man: Good to know. My cousin asked about it too — is there a family discount?
Woman: There is. If two or more people from the same household sign up together, each gets fifty yuan off.
Man: Perfect. Oh — and I heard the first fifty people to register this month get something free?
Woman: You heard right — a free stainless-steel water bottle, while stocks last.
Man: How do I book my sessions once I'm in?
Woman: Everything goes through our app — book, cancel or reschedule classes up to four hours in advance. You just scan your member card at the gate.
Man: And if I change my mind after joining?
Woman: If you cancel within seven days of signing up and you haven't started the course yet, you get a full refund. After that it's non-refundable, I'm afraid.
Man: Fair enough. One last thing — do I need a doctor's note?
Woman: Only if you have a heart condition or recent surgery. Otherwise, the assessment covers everything.
Man: Then please count me in. I'll come by this weekend to register.
Woman: Wonderful. See you then, and happy New Year!
